criterion: sum_i [w_i log(w_i/d_i) - w_i + d_i] with linear margins; base d_i=0 forces w_i=0
replicate_variance: (1/8) * sum_r (estimate_r - full_estimate)^2; this coefficient is supplied by the synthetic sampling design
nonresponse_assumption: after conditioning on supplied groups, response selection does not further depend on score; this cannot be established from these response-only data
